reason: The patch replaces the old `safeParse` call (which only logged the error) with `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:263). That helper throws `Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` when parsing fails (_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:21-23), so `prisma.credential.update` at CalendarService.ts:265 is never reached with stale credentials.
